# Asia Open Briefing: Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter lead times and higher pricing; lock in volumes now for most high‑risk parts.

## What changed
- Market supply risk nudged up to **70.7** (+0.1) and price trend to **84.5** (+0.1), both still in the “Elevated/Rising” zone[1].  
- TSMC foundry loading surged 50.9% YoY through Sep 2026, pushing supply risk higher[3].  
- Global chip sales jumped 146.1% YoY in Aug 2026, reinforcing price pressure[2].  
- Korea’s chip export days 1‑10 in Oct 2026 rose 171% YoY, a leading indicator of demand‑driven supply strain[5].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks** with **27,211** units in channel stock (≈17.7 weeks of supply).  
- Price **$5.56** for qty‑1, **$2.51** for 1 k units; origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %**.  
- Supply risk **52.8** (Neutral) and price trend **82.2** (Rising).  
- **Buy‑timing call:** “Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)” – 65 % chance prices rise in 3 months but supply is adequate, so fix price now and keep normal ordering cadence[6].


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – **Supply 69.9** (Rising, +0.1), **Price 81.5** (Rising), **High** confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – **Supply 71.3** (Elevated, –0.1), **Price 84.8** (Rising), **High** confidence.  
- Analog & power management – **Supply 66.2** (Rising, 0.0), **Price 83.3** (Rising), **High** confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – **Supply 68.1** (Rising, –1.5), **Price 82.1** (Rising), **High** confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – **Supply 63.4** (Rising, 0.0), **Price 82.4** (Rising), **High** confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – 52‑week lead time vs 12‑week norm, supply risk **83.1**.  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk **83.1**.  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk **83.1**.  
- **IS25LP128-JBLE** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk **83.0**.  
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk **82.6**, price % vs target **1717.2**.

## Outlook
- **Chip prices (3 mo):** 66 % chance of rise, expected **+2.17 %** (80 % range –9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑tested edge.  
- **Chip prices (6 mo):** 52 % chance of rise, expected **+4.34 %** (range –8.79 % to +17.46 %); trend‑following baseline.  
- **Fab utilization (3 mo):** 63 % chance of tighter supply, expected **+1.82 pts** (range –1.71 pts to +5.36 pts).  
- **Fab utilization (6 mo):** 60 % chance of tighter supply, expected **+3.64 pts** (range –2.16 pts to +9.45 pts).  

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock pricing on the five “no‑ahead” parts** (e.g., IPB017N10N5ATMA1) now to avoid the 65 % upside risk while leveraging adequate stock.  
2. **Request volume‑based discounts for the three 52‑week lead‑time logic parts**; their supply risk is elevated and price trends are high, giving you leverage for early commitments.  
3. **Push suppliers for tighter delivery windows on memory parts** (MT25QL128ABA1EW9‑0SIT) by offering longer‑term contracts, mitigating the 52‑week lead‑time bottleneck.
